acceptance: The cleaned preview action row contains five independently selectable non-story category checkboxes, an Apply Spacing button, and the existing Edit and Save buttons on one row; story is absent.
Heading and separator are checked by default, multiple selections are accepted, and Apply Spacing is disabled when compatible completed AI-cleanup decisions are unavailable or while editing/busy.

Apply Spacing rebuilds output without an AI request, emits exactly two LF characters for each selected artifact occurrence, removes unselected non-story artifacts, preserves story/source ordering and canonical whitespace, and is idempotent.

The applied selection and cleaned text persist across page refresh, downstream state is reset safely, and focused service, state, controller, page, traceability, coverage, style, and documentation checks pass.
assumptions: Heading and separator are selected by default so a newly completed AI cleanup preserves the current output behavior until the operator chooses otherwise.
Apply Spacing uses the current checkbox set as the complete selection: each selected non-story category emits exactly two LF characters and every unselected non-story category emits nothing.
Spacing is rebuilt idempotently from retained canonical source positions and validated AI decisions rather than modifying the preview text in place or calling the model again.
The control is available only for a completed compatible AI cleanup; a manual cleaned-text edit removes that eligibility so applying spacing cannot overwrite later manual edits.
Applying spacing persists the selected categories, refreshes the preview, and resets non-preserved downstream artifacts in the same way as a cleaned-text revision.
alignment.reason: The operation is deterministic, local, reversible by changing the selection and reapplying, preserves exact story text and the retained extraction, defaults to current behavior, and is covered by focused rendering and UI tests.
scope: AI Cleanup artifact rendering/reapplication, retained cleanup report/state needed for deterministic re-rendering, Text Cleanup page controls and controller wiring, localized labels, downstream reset/persistence behavior, focused tests, impacted durable functional/UX requirements, AI Cleanup component map/knowledge, and component documentation. No AI taxonomy or prompt change, no model rerun, no story checkbox, and no chunking or downstream algorithm change.

intent.statement: Let the operator select one or more non-story AI Cleanup artifact categories (heading, separator, noise, header, footer) and apply newline spacing from controls beside Edit and Save under the cleaned-text preview.

examples: With heading, noise, and footer selected, those artifact occurrences each emit two LF characters while separator and header emit nothing; story text and restored canonical whitespace remain exact.
spec_items.statement: AI Cleanup renders story blocks exactly and renders each non-story artifact block as two LF characters only when its category belongs to the complete spacing selection; all other non-story blocks render as empty.

Applying an AI Cleanup spacing selection rebuilds cleaned text idempotently from compatible retained validated source-position decisions, persists the selection and output, performs no provider call, and resets non-preserved downstream artifacts.
spec_items.threshold: Repeated application of the same selection produces byte-identical clean_text.txt content and zero provider requests.

examples: A deterministic cleanup or manually edited cleanup shows the controls but cannot apply spacing; a completed compatible AI cleanup can select one or multiple categories and apply them.
spec_items.statement: The Cleaned Text Preview action row exposes five independently selectable non-story category checkboxes and Apply Spacing beside Edit and Save, defaults heading and separator to selected, restores persisted selection, excludes story, and disables reapplication without compatible AI output or while busy/editing.
